sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:113

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:113:1
items.html: The ten Sefirot of ZA are reckoned from Hochma and below, called the beginning, and not from Keter and below: Namely for the reason that the Keter of ZA — besides its vessel being from the Tifferet of Tevuna — the light within it, too, is found to be of the discernment of Tevuna; therefore the Keter is not reckoned to the discernment of ZA, and it begins only from Hochma, as stated in its place.
